item.title: Black History Month centennial channels angst over anti-DEI climate into education, free resources
item.description: In the 100th year since the nation's earliest observances of Black History Month, celebrations will go on. The current political climate has energized civil rights organizations, artists and academics to engage young people on a full telling of America's story.
